lines: Q4 2026 Outlook – Weyerhaeuser anticipates fourth quarter earnings before special items will be approximately $35 million lower than the third quarter and Adjusted EBITDA will be approximately $45 million lower than the third quarter due to the timing and mix of Real Estate sales.

The company continues to expect full year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA to be approximately $450 million, a $25 million increase from the initial outlook, and basis as a percentage of Strategic Land Solutions sales to be 15 to 20 percent for the full year.
